jobs.name: 凯尔特哲学
jobs.cue: Forest grove, complete carved standing stones and tall Celtic cross, tree trunk spiral carvings, mossy stream and foreground spiral-carved rocks, distant misty valley and sunlight shafts. Preserve empty landscape with NO invented druids or extra people.
jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / outpainting. ONE 16:9 landscape version of the attached approved artwork. This is ASPECT-RATIO REPAIR ONLY. Preserve its existing style, colors, figures, facial expressions, gestures, all identifiable objects and cultural architecture. Place the COMPLETE original 4:3 scene within the central three quarters of the wide canvas. Keep ALL original top/bottom content, including foreground instruments/books/figures and highest branches/buildings. Extend left/right edges with quiet adjacent terrain/architecture/materials that naturally follow existing perspective, lighting and brushwork. Do not crop, stretch, squeeze, redesign, simplify, substitute portraits or change the original palette. Keep all principal narrative groups and their relative positions/counts. No new characters, unrelated symbolism, labels, diagrams, large lettering, watermark or comparison panel. Small natural inscriptions already on source objects may remain. Maintain coherent anatomy, fine readable hands and distinctive activities; no duplicated limbs. Existing style is good: conservative lateral extension, not wholesale repainting. Preserve the following recognition cues in their existing contexts: Forest grove, complete carved standing stones and tall Celtic cross, tree trunk spiral carvings, mossy stream and foreground spiral-carved rocks, distant misty valley and sunlight shafts. Preserve empty landscape with NO invented druids or extra people.

Preserve its authentic fresco painterly material and pale colors; NEVER reinterpret it as a photograph or oil-rendered imitation. jobs.name: 前苏格拉底哲学
jobs.cue: Keep Mediterranean coast, boats and Greek temples, whole philosophical discussion and distinct pointing/observing gestures, geometry inscribed quietly on ground, water and foreground small fire as natural elements, starry sky and restrained cosmic circular traces. Oil refinement should use finer balanced strokes, not very chunky impasto or a swirling expressionist sky. Keep original light, scene layout and restrained individual faces.
jobs.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. ONE 16:9 cinematic oil painting refinement of the supplied image, which is the EDIT TARGET. Its composition and 16:9 dimensions already fit the website: keep the full frame, principal scene, foreground/midground/background, people count, facial individuality, all characteristic cultural dress, meaningful gestures, buildings, animals and narrative objects in their original relative positions. Change painterly material and surface handling, not the subject or culture. Strong but refined visible oil brushwork in clouds, rock, water and fabric; finer strokes on expressive faces, hands and tools. Form comes from painted color planes and glazes, with selective thicker highlights and softly merged distant edges, rather than photographic detail, waxy skin, CGI metallic/plastic gloss or a coarse filter. Preserve original color relationships and directional light; no blanket golden/sepia tint. Maintain believable anatomy (two arms/hands per person), distinct human identities as depicted, no cloned faces. No Europeanized architecture or transplanted Western dress, invented modern tools, giant symbols, labels, logos, watermarks or collage. Small inscriptions naturally on existing objects can remain. Preserve these specific scene elements and recognition cues: Keep Mediterranean coast, boats and Greek temples, whole philosophical discussion and distinct pointing/observing gestures, geometry inscribed quietly on ground, water and foreground small fire as natural elements, starry sky and restrained cosmic circular traces. Oil refinement should use finer balanced strokes, not very chunky impasto or a swirling expressionist sky. Keep original light, scene layout and restrained individual faces.
